blocks.content: Quiz: What's the variable in the following code?
jack = "name"
Tap an option below to answer:
jack
Correct Answer!
In the above code, jack is a variable. In Python, the value on the right of the = symbol ("name") is assigned to the variable on the left of the = symbol (jack).
